<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `device_id` (String) The device ID, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.
- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of a user&device combination. Format: "CN=,CN=,OU="
- `duration_seconds` (Number) The duration of the session in seconds.
- `entitlement` (String) The ID of the Entitlement the session is associated with.
- `entitlement_name` (String) The name of the Entitlement the session is associated with.
- `gateway_id` (String) The ID of the Gateway that reported this session. Use this when terminating the session.
- `host` (String) The host the session is connected to.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the brokered session. A 32-char raw-hex guac session token, not a UUID.
- `monitoring` (Boolean) Whether the session can be observed live.
- `provider_name` (String) The provider name of the user, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.
- `recording` (Boolean) Whether the session is being recorded.
- `site` (String) The ID of the Site the Gateway is assigned to.
- `site_name` (String) The name of the Site the Gateway is assigned to.
- `type` (String) The type of the brokered session.
- `username` (String) The username, same as the one in the Distinguished Name.
